query: select n.nspname as schema_name, c.relname as table_name, c.relkind, c.relrowsecurity as rls_enabled, c.relforcerowsecurity as rls_forced from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and c.relkind in ('r','p','v','m','f') order by 1,2;
